import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class FlowEdge {
        int to, capacity, flow, rev;
        FlowEdge(int t, int c, int f, int r) {
            to = t;
            capacity = c;
            flow = f;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 11;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int MAXNODES = 2 * MAXN * MAXN;

    static List<FlowEdge>[] g = new List[MAXNODES];
    static int[] distToLevel = new int[MAXN * MAXN];
    static int[] currentEdgeIndex = new int[MAXN * MAXN];
    static int sourceNode, sinkNode, n;
    static Queue<Integer> qBfs = new LinkedList<>();
    static Queue<int[]> workQueue = new LinkedList<>();
    static final int[] dirX = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dirY = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][][] shortestDist = new int[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];
    static int timeLimit;
    static char[][] boardA = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] boardB = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dangerCell = new int[2];

    static void insertEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        g[u].add(new FlowEdge(v, cap, 0, 0));
        g[v].add(new FlowEdge(u, 0, 0, 0));
        g[u].get(g[u].size() - 1).rev = g[v].size() - 1;
        g[v].get(g[v].size() - 1).rev = g[u].size() - 1;
    }

    static boolean buildLevelGraph() {
        Arrays.fill(distToLevel, 0, sinkNode + 1, INF);
        distToLevel[sourceNode] = 0;
        qBfs.add(sourceNode);
        while (!qBfs.isEmpty()) {
            int u = qBfs.poll();
            for (FlowEdge e : g[u]) {
                int v = e.to;
                int residual = e.capacity - e.flow;
                if (distToLevel[v] == INF && residual > 0) {
                    distToLevel[v] = distToLevel[u] + 1;
                    qBfs.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return distToLevel[sinkNode] != INF;
    }

    static int blockingFlow(int u, int flowLimit) {
        if (u == sinkNode) return flowLimit;
        for (int i = currentEdgeIndex[u]; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
            currentEdgeIndex[u] = i;
            FlowEdge e = g[u].get(i);
            int v = e.to;
            int residual = e.capacity - e.flow;
            if (distToLevel[v] == distToLevel[u] + 1 && residual > 0) {
                int extra = blockingFlow(v, Math.min(flowLimit, residual));
                if (extra > 0) {
                    e.flow += extra;
                    g[v].get(e.rev).flow -= extra;
                    return extra;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (buildLevelGraph()) {
            Arrays.fill(currentEdgeIndex, 0);
            int delta;
            while ((delta = blockingFlow(sourceNode, INF)) > 0) {
                total += delta;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static boolean inBounds(int[] p) {
        return p[0] >= 0 && p[0] < n && p[1] >= 0 && p[1] < n && 
               boardA[p[0]][p[1]] != 'Y' && boardA[p[0]][p[1]] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsCompute(int x0, int y0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                shortestDist[x0][y0][i][j] = INF;
        shortestDist[x0][y0][x0][y0] = 0;
        workQueue.add(new int[]{x0, y0});
        while (!workQueue.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = workQueue.poll();
            if (shortestDist[x0][y0][p[0]][p[1]] == shortestDist[dangerCell[0]][dangerCell[1]][p[0]][p[1]] && 
                (dangerCell[0] != x0 || dangerCell[1] != y0)) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int[] np = new int[]{p[0] + dirX[k], p[1] + dirY[k]};
                if (inBounds(np) && shortestDist[x0][y0][np[0]][np[1]] == INF && 
                    shortestDist[x0][y0][p[0]][p[1]] + 1 <= shortestDist[dangerCell[0]][dangerCell[1]][np[0]][np[1]]) {
                    shortestDist[x0][y0][np[0]][np[1]] = shortestDist[x0][y0][p[0]][p[1]] + 1;
                    workQueue.add(np);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        timeLimit = sc.nextInt();
        int px = 0, py = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                boardA[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
                if (boardA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    px = i;
                    py = j;
                }
            }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                boardB[i][j] = sc.next().charAt(0);
        
        dangerCell[0] = px;
        dangerCell[1] = py;
        bfsCompute(px, py);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                shortestDist[dangerCell[0]][dangerCell[1]][i][j] = 
                    Math.min(shortestDist[dangerCell[0]][dangerCell[1]][i][j], timeLimit);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (inBounds(new int[]{i, j}))
                    bfsCompute(i, j);
        
        sourceNode = 0;
        sinkNode = 2 * n * n + 1;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXNODES; ++i)
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (boardA[i][j] != '0')
                    insertEdge(sourceNode, i * n + j + 1, boardA[i][j] - '0');
                if (boardB[i][j] != '0')
                    insertEdge(i * n + j + 1 + n * n, sinkNode, boardB[i][j] - '0');
            }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; ++i1)
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; ++j1)
                        if (inBounds(new int[]{i, j}) && inBounds(new int[]{i1, j1}) && 
                            shortestDist[i][j][i1][j1] <= shortestDist[px][py][i1][j1])
                            insertEdge(i * n + j + 1, i1 * n + j1 + 1 + n * n, INF);
        
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }
}
